item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Validating Admission Policies: CEL vs OPA Gatekeeper vs Kyverno (2026)
item.description: Kubernetes admission controllers intercept API requests before objects are persisted to etcd. Validating admission controllers enforce organizational policies — requiring labels, restricting container images, preventing privileged containers. This guide compares three approaches to admission control in self-hosted Kubernetes clusters.
